description: This file defines the UserService class within a CRM API project. The class provides functionality to retrieve current user information based on OAuth2 tokens, constructing JSON API responses. It includes dependencies on helper classes and interacts with a BeanManager for data retrieval.

classes.name: UserService
classes.description: Provides user-related API functionalities, specifically to fetch the current user's data based on OAuth2 token authentication inside the SuiteCRM/CRM platform.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the UserService with dependencies for managing beans and JSON API response helpers.

methods.name: getCurrentUser
methods.description: Retrieves the current authenticated user's information by validating the OAuth token, then constructs and returns a structured JSON API DocumentResponse containing user data and relationships.
